name: Advanced Frame Counter
description: Real gameplay-tick frame data, frame-window buckets, input recording and replay analysis.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off the mod observes nothing.

method.name: Measurement Method
method.description: direct = Method 1 (gameplay tick/gap), probe = Method 2 (state window analysis), replay = Method 3 (recorded replay analysis). Methods 2/3 need 'Allow experimental probing'.

record-auto.name: Record Automatically
record-auto.description: Start recording real inputs at the start of every attempt.

show-history.name: Show History
show-history.description: Show the last 3 measurements under the HUD.

hud-x.name: HUD X Offset
hud-x.description: Pushes the HUD away from the chosen corner (use to avoid camera notches).

label-y.name: Player Label Y Offset
label-y.description: Added to the default distance above the player; flips with gravity.

label-hold-seconds.name: Label Hold Time (s)
label-hold-seconds.description: UI fade only: how long a label stays before fading. Not a frame source.

compact-mode.name: Compact Mode
compact-mode.description: Hide the HUD header and prefix every value with its player.

pause-button-mode.name: Pause Button Placement
pause-button-mode.description: auto = join the pause menu's button column (re-flows around other mods). floating = own position below.

rec-auto-restart.name: Keep Recording After Death
rec-auto-restart.description: A recording covers one attempt. When on, a new recording starts at the next attempt (needs 'Record Automatically' to chain).

playback-enabled.name: Allow Playback (injects inputs)
playback-enabled.description: Lets the mod replay a recorded run by feeding inputs to the game. Off by default: the mod is observational.

analysis-mode.name: Display Mode
analysis-mode.description: live = latest value, analysis = bucket counts, compare = Methods 1/2/3 side by side.

allow-experimental.name: Allow Experimental Probing
allow-experimental.description: Enables Methods 2 and 3, which snapshot and re-simulate game state. Not verified on a device.

probe-range.name: Probe Range (ticks)
probe-range.description: Shifts tested on each side of the real input.

probe-horizon.name: Probe Horizon (ticks)
probe-horizon.description: How many ticks after the input the player must stay alive.

probe-auto-pause.name: Analyze On Pause (Method 2)
probe-auto-pause.description: Start Method 2 analysis automatically when the game is paused.

analysis-budget-ms.name: Analysis Time Slice (ms)
analysis-budget-ms.description: Work per rendered frame while analyzing (paused).
